list.title: Amateka y'uko inzu zimeze
list.subtitle: Amasuzuma yose y'inzu zawe, aheruka mbere.
list.emptyText: Kora isuzuma ryo kwinjira kugira ngo ubike ikimenyetso cy'uko buri nzu imeze.

wizard.roomsHelp: Hitamo ibyumba biri muri iyi nzu. Ushobora kongeramo ibindi hasi.
wizard.conditionHelp: Kuri buri kintu, hitamo ijambo rigisobanura neza. Sobanura ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose ubonye.
wizard.allGood: Emeza ko byose muri iki cyumba ari byiza
wizard.autosave: Aho ugeze habikwa igihe cyose ukanze Komeza.
wizard.photosHelp: Fata amafoto ya buri cyumba, cyane cyane ahangiritse.
wizard.photosOptional: Amafoto si ngombwa ariko arasabwa cyane.
wizard.summaryHint: Ijambo rigufi rusange, urugero “Inzu isukuye kandi iteguye umupangayi.”
wizard.shareHint: Umupangayi w'ubu ashobora kubona uko ibintu bimeze n'amafoto (si ibyitonderwa byawe bwite).
wizard.lockWarning: Nurangiza, iri suzuma rizafungwa ribe inyandiko ihoraho ifite itariki. Ntirizongera guhindurwa.
wizard.draftSaved: Isuzuma ryawe ryabitswe. Ushobora kurikomeza nyuma.

detail.deleteConfirm: Iri suzuma ritarangiye n'amafoto yaryo bizasibwa. Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.
detail.lockedText: Iri suzuma ryarangiye kandi ntirishobora kongera guhindurwa.
detail.draftText: Iri suzuma ntirirangira. Rikomeze kugira ngo urirangize kandi urifunge.

compare.title: Gereranya amafoto
compare.needTwo: Hakenewe nibura amafoto abiri kugira ngo ugereranye.
compare.disclaimer: Aya mafoto ni inyandiko zifite amatariki gusa. Ntabwo agaragaza uwateje icyangiritse — ibyo ni ibyo abantu bumvikanaho.
